app.name: Gekko2 SPEED BETA12.27 GX RISK OPTION
app.long_description: Common experimental GS-to-GX renderer with an independent GX RISK MODE - FAST TRIANGLES menu option. Factory OFF; saved setting applies at next Cold Boot. ON reduces eligible triangle submissions but may change edge pixels. Pixel permissions, memory/alias checks and GX fences remain. Chain/PSM settings stay independent. No confirmed Wii FPS or gameplay improvement. Bring your own legal BIOS/disc.
